title: Australia is wider than the Moon

upload.title: Could Australia Actually Be Wider Than the Moon? 🇦🇺🌕
upload.description: Australia stretches about 4,000 kilometers from west to east, easily beating the Moon's width of 3,474 kilometers. Even with that immense scale, most Australians live clustered near the coast.

scenes.title: Is Australia *wider* than the Moon?
scenes.vo: Did you know that Australia is actually wider than the Moon?
scenes.caption: Did you know that Australia is actually wider than the Moon?

scenes.title: About *4,000 km* wide
scenes.vo: It sounds unbelievable, but look at the scale. Australia is about 4,000 kilometers wide from west to east.
scenes.caption: It sounds unbelievable, but look at the scale. Australia is about 4,000 kilometers wide from west to east.

scenes.title: The *Moon* across
scenes.vo: Now compare that to our celestial neighbor. The Moon is about 3,474 kilometers across.
scenes.caption: Now compare that to our celestial neighbor. The Moon is about 3,474 kilometers across.

scenes.title: *Wider* than the Moon
scenes.vo: So Australia is wider than the Moon. From west to east, this one continent stretches further than the Moon is across.
scenes.caption: So Australia is wider than the Moon. From west to east, this one continent stretches further than the Moon is across.

scenes.title: Living near the *coast*
scenes.vo: Yet across this enormous span, most Australians live near the coast.
scenes.caption: Yet across this enormous span, most Australians live near the coast.

scenes.title: Clustered in the *south-east*
scenes.vo: From Perth on the west coast to Brisbane and Sydney, most Australians live near the coast, especially in the south-east.
scenes.caption: From Perth on the west coast to Brisbane and Sydney, most Australians live near the coast, especially in the south-east.
